items.title: How Meta's Muse, Vanguard AI Threat Triggered Schwab Sell Signal
items.summary: Charles Schwab stock recovered only modestly on Wednesday morning, a day after leading a wide swath of brokerage, bank and other financial stocks lower as AI-fueled competition heats up.  Rapid adoption of Meta Platforms' Muse personal AI agent and a growing threat from Altruist, an AI platform for financial advisors that was recently acquired by Vanguard, have highlighted two very different type of risks to Schwab's business.

items.title: China's AI Development Moving From Policy Ambition to Commercial Reality
items.summary: China's AI development is moving from policy ambition to commercial reality, BofA Securities said in a research note. "Domestic capabilities and adoption are advancing despite gaps in leading-edge hardware, while improvements in model efficiency and system optimization could support commercial viability before full technological self-sufficiency," the bank said.
